name: Joseph
bio: Joseph is the firstborn son of Jacob and Rachel, one of Jacob's most beloved children. When Rachel bore him she said, "God hath taken away my reproach," and named him "Joseph," meaning "he adds," hoping the LORD would add her another son as well (Genesis 30:22-24). Joseph's most dramatic story — sold into Egypt by his own brothers, his experiences in Potiphar's house and in prison, his rise to power by interpreting Pharaoh's dreams, and his eventual reconciliation with his brothers and reunion of the whole family in Egypt — is told in full across Genesis 37-50, the longest and richest individual story in the entire book, and will be covered in detail as that part of Genesis is added.
